name: A.I.M.S. Ecosystem
description: A.I.M.S. (AI Managed Solutions) — the unified platform ecosystem. AIMS is the execution hub. ACHEEVY is the digital CEO, consistent across all platforms. PlugMeIn is the immersion and marketing hub. All repos are feeder and development satellites serving the ecosystem.

branding.chatIconRule: ACHEEVY Helmet is the ONLY primary avatar for all chat interfaces across all repos. One narrator (ACHEEVY). Many capabilities (aiPLUGs). aiPLUGs may have secondary icon/badge inside their card/module UI.

pathways._doc: ClawReflex: pathways become reflex (deterministic, no deliberation) after validation. Otherwise reasoning (allowed to deliberate, propose alternates, request HITL).

aims-to-gateway.description: AIMS frontend to UEF Gateway for all external API access

acheevy-to-plugs.description: ACHEEVY selects and invokes aiPLUGs from the catalog

chickenhawk-dispatch.description: Chicken Hawk dispatches Lil_Hawks and enforces SOP

luc-calculation.description: LUC calculation engine for financial/locale computations

grammar-nlp.description: GRAMMAR NLP + LibreChat integration for text intelligence

live-look-in.description: Live Look In real-time workspace viewer — observes agent activity across the ecosystem via Redis event bus

aims.label: A.I.M.S. — Execution Hub
aims.description: AI Managed Solutions — the brain, orchestrator, and single source of truth. Next.js frontend, UEF Gateway, ACHEEVY service, aiPLUGS, CRM, command center. Deploys to VPS Docker.

myclaw.label: MyClaw — Infra & Runtime Substrate
myclaw.description: Hub for OpenClaw and Foai.cloud. Container templates, Docker compositions, deployment scripts. Serves the ecosystem but does not define it.

acheevy-digital.label: ACHEEVY.digital — Official ACHEEVY Domain
acheevy-digital.description: Builds ACHEEVY capabilities officially. Has its own domain. The public face of ACHEEVY — brand, onboarding, showcase. Routes through AIMS for registry and orchestration.

chicken-hawk.label: Chicken Hawk — Coordinator & Safety
chicken-hawk.description: Master execution agent embodied as OpenClaw. Dispatches Lil_Hawks, enforces SOP, runs gateway system. Chicken Hawk = OpenClaw = NemoClaw = MyClaw runtime identity.

agent-acheevy-009.label: Agent ACHEEVY-009 — Boomer_Ang Runtime
agent-acheevy-009.description: Autonomous AI agent framework. Python-based agent with E2B sandbox, Playwright MCP, chat server. Powers Boomer_Ang agent execution.

grammar.label: GRAMMAR — NLP & Chat Engine
grammar.description: Next.js frontend + LibreChat-based backend for natural language processing, grammar analysis, text intelligence, and Remotion video generation.

acheevy-whisper-build.label: ACHEEVY Whisper — Speech-to-Text
acheevy-whisper-build.description: Whisper-based STT service powering voice input across the AIMS platform. Voice-first is default.

destinations-ai.label: Destinations AI — Location Intelligence
destinations-ai.description: AI-powered location, travel, and destination intelligence engine.

the-perform-platform.label: Per|Form — Analytics & KPI Platform
the-perform-platform.description: Performance tracking, KPI analytics, business intelligence. Houses OKAI (Open|Klass AI), scout-hub, film-room, war-room.

luc.label: LUC — Locale Universal Calculator
luc.description: Multi-locale financial calculator, currency conversion, cost-of-living, K1 taxation, Zakat/VAT. Foundation built from Flip Secrets real estate calculator. Gates all billable actions.

locale-v2.label: Locale by ACHIEVEMOR v2 — Locale Frontend
locale-v2.description: Next-gen Locale frontend with ACHIEVEMOR integration. Consumer UI for the LUC calculation engine.

ch-docs.label: CH-Docs — Chicken Hawk Documentation
ch-docs.description: All Chicken Hawk documentation files. System prompts, gateway configs, dispatch SOPs, safety policies, coordinator architecture, Lil_Hawk management rules. CH = Chicken Hawk.

rules.singleNarrator: Only ACHEEVY speaks to users. Never expose Boomer_Ang, Lil_Hawk, or Chicken Hawk names in public UI.
rules.noDuplicateBrains: If two repos both claim authority over the same domain, one must become the adapter. ACHEEVY is the digital CEO duplicated across repos for consistency.
rules.evidenceRequired: Every completed task requires evidence. No proof, no done.
rules.noMockData: This is commercial software. Done means safely distributable to anyone.
rules.reflexPromotion: A pathway only becomes reflex after a validation run produces artifacts/logs meeting ship-block standards.
rules.apiKeyStorage: All real API keys are stored on the OpenClaw VPS platform. Never in repos. Repos use .env.example templates only.
